description: Education collection: campus notices vs education-themed lures.

samples.message: Dear Students, the Placement Cell announces a campus drive by Infosys on 12th March. Register on the college portal by 10th March.
University convocation on 15th March. All graduating students are hereby informed to collect gowns from the registrar office.
Reminder: semester fee payment deadline is 20th September. Pay on the student portal to avoid late charges. - Accounts Office
Congratulations to the CSE batch placed in Accenture! Pre-placement talk by Deloitte tomorrow at Seminar Hall A.
Your scholarship of Rs.50,000 has been approved! Pay Rs.1,500 verification fee on the link to release it today.
URGENT: Your admission will be cancelled today. Confirm your seat by paying Rs.25,000 at this private link immediately.
Online degree in 30 days, UGC approved, no exams needed. Pay full fee upfront for guaranteed certificate. Limited seats!
Library books due on 18th September. Renew online or visit the circulation desk. Fine of Rs.5 per day applies after due date.
Admit cards for end-semester exams are available on the portal. Download and verify your photograph before 25th September.
Earn Rs.2,000 per day doing online assignments from home. No experience needed, just pay Rs.999 registration on the app.
